steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Frostleaf? Frostleaf?!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What's going on...

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Amiya! This is the 2nd Recon Squad....

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: We're currently retreating! But, the enemy...

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Reunion...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It cut out again?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: 3rd Recon Squad! Do you copy? 3rd Recon Squad!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit! It's me! Did you get--

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I've been continuously monitoring them from the bridge.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I need you to ask something to that officer next to you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Ask her...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: 'How long does Lungmen intend to keep playing dumb?'

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'll pretend I didn't hear that.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But, we certainly don't have time to waste.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What happened? I just went to grab some forms, and you two look all serious now.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...A new mission?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Everyone... Gear up. It's about time for us to head out.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, I'm am formally requesting that the L.G.D. provide assistance to Rhodes Island on this rescue mission.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We may even be dealing with Reunion's new temporary headquarters...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Furthermore, I believe that our recon squads are still out there fighting, even if we can't see them...
